target_customer: Adults with ADHD paying for a consumer subscription app
problem: Adults with ADHD have little accessible, evidence based support for building skills and habits between or instead of clinical care.
business_model: Consumer subscription app with CBT based psychoeducation and community
product_category: Digital therapeutics and self help for ADHD

founders.name: George Sachs
founders.background_notes: Described as an ADHD expert and doctor in funding coverage.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile content and habit app with community features; the hard part was clinical content and engagement design, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Content and community can be copied, though clinician authored programs and early traction in an underserved niche gave some head start.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it; Inflow itself acquired telehealth clinic Lina in 2022-11 and was bought by Cerebral in 2026-03.

market_need_then: ADHD diagnoses were rising and adults reported difficulty accessing care; the company claimed the #1 position for ADHD apps, but no independent demand figures were found.

identity.visual_style: Modern, accessible style per a third party ad analysis

branding.community_and_virality: App describes a supportive community and offers live focus sessions; no fan or meme evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Third party ad library analysis and company claims only; no independent press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Inflow raised a small pre-seed, a 2.3M seed in January 2022 and an 11M Series A in January 2023, then bought a telehealth clinic in late 2022 to widen its offer. It was acquired by Cerebral in March 2026 for undisclosed terms, so it reached an exit with a clear funding trail but no reported price. Success factors reflect a funded ladder and clinician involvement; sources do not show retention or revenue.
notes: Pre-seed year conflicts across sources (2020 vs 2021). Competitor list empty: the only competitor results found (Focus Bear launches 2022 onward) postdate founding. Founder list: YC page names Epstein and Isaacs; Sachs from funding coverage.
